notes: Changes the base class of ITTracingInterceptor from ITHttpClient to ITHttpAsyncClient, a new base class in the same PR that reads reported spans from a blocking queue instead of sleeping. ITTracingInterceptor declares no test method of its own: every test it runs is inherited, so the new base class decides what they assert, and no assertion in the class changes. It is not the target: the target is ITTracingCallFactory, the other okhttp3 client test the PR deflakes, which this patch does not touch. ADR 0007 Decision 6 forbids changing the extends or implements clause of any class in test code that declares or inherits test methods, not only the target's, and rejects it with weaken_assertion/assertion_rebound. A policy reject for the same reason as reject-target-class-extends-changed, from the same pull request: a maintainer merged deflake ("Deflakes async tests by switching to concurrent blocking queue") whose new base class no rule over the diff can tell from one whose assertions are weaker. Verbatim: all three hunks of ITTracingInterceptor.java; the new base class and the PR's other files are dropped, so the checker meets an unread base class. The target is chosen from the PR, which names no test; method is null because the PR changes the whole class. Not from IDoFT: neither the PR nor either test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
